newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Innovative warrants debut on August 30.
newsitem.headline: Innovative warrants debut on August 30.

text.p: Cellular phone antenna manufacturer Innovative International (Holdings) Ltd said dealing in its 48 million 1996-1997 warrants and 48 million 1996-1998 warrants would commence trading on August 30.

Last month, the company placed the 96 million warants to institutional and private investors at an issue price of HK$0.53 per warrant, raising funds for building an antennae production plant in China's Dongguan.
The 1997 warrants will give holders the right to subscribe one new Innovative share at HK$2.40 and the 1998 warrants are exercisable at HK$2.75 each. - HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
